title: Why a prosecution of Anthony Fauci could face challenges in court
description: The Justice Department faces numerous pressures and challenges as it decides whether to prosecute Anthony Fauci following a Senate committee's contempt referral.

title: Trump says he’ll bring ballroom fight to Supreme Court after lower court halts work
description: An appeals court ruled earlier Friday that construction must stop until Congress authorizes the project. The ballroom is among the president’s top priorities for this term.

title: Cassidy backs Blanche for attorney general, appearing to clear way for confirmation
description: The Senate could hold the final vote on President Donald Trump’s pick to lead the Justice Department as soon as Friday.

title: Trump won’t let the Supreme Court have the last word
description: The president moved this week to counter legal defeats on ending birthright citizenship and firing a Fed governor, while seeking the justices’ help with his ballroom.

title: Court deals setback to Trump’s war on wind as Pentagon is ordered to review projects
description: The Defense Department stopped processing national security reviews of wind projects in May, despite a law demanding they be completed in 75 days.

title: What happened under Trump this week
description: The administration approved a new flu shot but is raising fresh questions about the relationship between autism and other vaccines.

title: One chart shows the backlash to gutting the Voting Rights Act
description: Democratic turnout for House primaries in Shelby County, Tennessee, a majority-Black county, surged to the highest level in a decade.

title: Women in Maine may choose the victor in this year's Senate race
description: The race between Susan Collins and Troy Jackson is one of the nation's most high-profile Senate contests this year -- and may ultimately be decided by an especially powerful voting bloc: Maine women.

title: Another court blocks White House ballroom work, teeing up a Supreme Court review
description: A federal appeals court says above-ground construction cannot continue without approval from Congress, siding with historic preservation advocates.

title: Tariffs on brass instruments come too late for unemployed Ohio factory workers
description: The tariff proposal was announced three days after The Post's story on the shuttered factory.

title: Senate passes Russia sanctions bill that was long championed by Lindsey Graham
description: The bill is meant to stifle Russia's economy by allowing for tough new tariffs against major importers of Russian energy. The legislation was led by Lindsey Graham before his unexpected death in July.

title: Trump says he’d ‘probably get along’ with Jeffries as House speaker
description: Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries (D-New York) is likely to lead the chamber if Democrats win it back.

title: Blanche's path to confirmation appears clear after winning key Republican's support
description: A key Republican senator, Bill Cassidy of Louisiana, said he would back Todd Blanche's nomination as attorney general, smoothing the path for his ultimate confirmation by the Senate.

title: The Senate wants a recess. Trump doesn’t.
description: Before senators leave for recess, Republican leaders are trying to plow through a lengthy to-do list.

title: In Texas, the economy rather than abortion takes center stage
description: Senate contenders James Talarico and Ken Paxton unveil dueling economic plans as this year’s campaigns turn from the culture wars that defined the state’s 2024 vote.

title: Sen. Mitch McConnell says he has been discharged from rehab center to recover at home
description: Kentucky Sen. Mitch McConnell said he was discharged from his rehabilitation center in a Thursday statement, more than 50 days after hospitalization.

title: Trump tries new tack against birthright citizenship after Supreme Court snub
description: The president signed executive orders that target children born to “alien enemies,” foreign lobbyists or tourists. The orders are certain to face legal challenges.

title: McConnell discharged from rehab center, will continue recovery at home
description: The Kentucky Republican has been absent from the Senate since he was hospitalized June 14 following a fall at home.

title: Senate panel votes to hold Anthony Fauci in contempt of Congress
description: The longtime infectious-disease scientist refused to answer questions from committee members at a hearing last week.

title: Ohio’s other GOP senator calls on Rep. Max Miller to resign
description: Sen. Jon Husted joined Sen. Bernie Moreno, Miller’s former father-in-law, in calling for the embattled congressman to step aside.

title: Francesca Hong scrutinized over ‘cancel Thanksgiving’ post in Wisconsin governor race
description: Hong, a democratic socialist running for Wisconsin governor, is getting attention for social media posts calling for canceling Thanksgiving and abolishing police.

title: Trump signs new orders targeting birthright citizenship, weeks after Supreme Court ruling
description: President Trump is once again attempting to put restrictions on who is automatically guaranteed citizenship after being born in the U.S., just weeks after the Supreme Court struck down his attempt to end birthright citizenship.

title: Minnesota prosecutor asks Texas to extradite ICE agent to face charges in shooting case
description: The county attorney asked Gov. Greg Abbott to authorize the extradition of Immigration and Customs Enforcement officer Christian Castro on charges of assault.

title: The Senate voted to hold Dr. Fauci in contempt. Now what?
description: A Senate committee voted to hold Dr. Anthony Fauci in contempt after he refused to answer questions about his handling of the covid pandemic. Chairman Rand Paul plans to refer the case to the DOJ.

title: Dodgeball! Kickball! Trump’s Patriot Games will look a lot like gym class.
description: The Patriot Games now have an official schedule, with events Sunday, Monday and Tuesday.

title: What’s up with all these scandals in Congress?
description: One lawmaker faces domestic abuse allegations; another, allegations of inappropriate behavior toward female staffers.

title: Trump-linked law firm to get $150 million no-bid contract to represent migrant children
description: The Trump administration announced the award after allowing the previous contract with a longtime legal provider to expire.

title: The park service says Trump's arch would obstruct historic sites. Could it be moved?
description: President Trump's proposed arch in Memorial Circle would intrude on dozens of nearby sites, says the National Park Service. But there's been minimal discussion of alternate locations.

title: Senate Democrats probe Korean firm’s $2 million payment to Trump company
description: Base Co. LTD was fighting a trade case before the Commerce Department at the time of the payment.

title: U.S.-Canada relations go up in smoke
description: There’s been something in the air in D.C. this summer — namely wildfire smoke and frustration over Canada’s inability to keep it on its side of the border.

title: Why you shouldn’t be surprised if Democrats don’t flip the House
description: Democrats are ahead in polls, and voters typically punish the party that controls the White House during midterms. But Republicans have several paths to maintaining power.

title: El-Sayed wins Michigan's primary. And, Fauci faces contempt of Congress vote
description: Abdul El-Sayed has won Michigan's Democratic Senate primary and will face Republican Congressman Mike Rogers in the midterms. And, today, Dr. Anthony Fauci faces a contempt of Congress vote.

title: Political consultant talks about the Democratic Party's road to the midterms
description: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with political consultant David Axelrod about Democrats' road to November and what's ahead for Michigan's Democratic U.S. Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed.
